After installation, **"Usage & Cost"** and **"Bala"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"nce Query"** tabs appear in the Web UI, right after "Conversation" and "Trace":"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"> Supports **Windows / macOS / Linux**: paths are handled per platform (`node:path`), and the folder"},{"id":"p9s2","text":" picker / "reveal in file manager" use each OS's native mechanism (macOS: `osascript` / `open`; Linu"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"x: `zenity` / `xdg-open`). Balance query and export do not depend on Windows-only commands."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Usage & Cost**: records each model call's token usage and cache hits (input miss / cache hit / c"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ache write / output / reasoning / finish reason), and computes cost using DeepSeek's peak/valley or "},{"id":"p10s3","text":"base pricing (peak hours on weekdays are automatically priced by Beijing time 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"18:00; since 2026-08-23 weekends are billed entirely at the off-peak rate; since 2026-09-10 12:00 Be"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ijing time the post-V4.1-Flash peak/valley prices apply — `deepseek-flash` off-peak cache hit 0.02 /"},{"id":"p10s6","text":" input 1 / output 4 CNY, peak at twice that). Model names come from the actual request parameters, s"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"o non-DeepSeek models are shown truthfully instead of "unknown model"; models without an official pr"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"ice are counted as 0. The overview shows a by-model table plus a by-API-provider × model drill-down "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"(each provider grouped with every model's calls and peak/off-peak cost split) and a grand total row."},{"id":"p10s10","text":" The overview also supports **date filtering** (Today / Last 7 days / Last 30 days / All, plus a cus"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"tom start–end range), so the aggregate stats can be scoped to any single day or date range.

- Make sure `dsh` is on PATH (for the desktop app, run in its bundled terminal)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"### 1.
